sources.evidence_extract: TI SBOS786B (April 2016, revised April 2022), PDF metadata creation 2025-11-10; retained in Takazudo/circuit-dev-resources texas-instruments/ina301-q1/ina301-q1-datasheet-sbos786b.pdf. AEC-Q100 grade 1, -40..125 C ambient. DGK pins: 1 VS, 2 OUT, 3 LIMIT, 4 GND, 5 RESET, 6 ALERT (active-low open drain), 7 IN-, 8 IN+. EC TA 25 C VS 5 V: VCM 0..36 V; INA301A3-Q1 VIN 0..50 mV; VOS +/-35 uV max; drift 0.5 uV/C max -40..125 C; gain 100 V/V; gain error +/-0.2 % max (VOUT 0.5 V to VS-0.5 V), 10 ppm/C max -40..125 C; total alert propagation delay 1 us max at 1 mV overdrive; slew-rate-limited tp 1.5 us max (VOUT step 0.5..4.5 V, VLIMIT 4 V); ILIMIT 79.7..80.3 uA at 25 C and 79.2..80.8 uA -40..125 C; comparator VOS 4.5 mV max (A3), hysteresis 100 mV typ. Abs max VS 6 V; IN+/IN- common mode GND-0.3..40 V. Orderable INA301A3QDGKTQ1: Active, VSSOP (DGK) 8, 250 small T&R, -40..125 C, marking ZGJ6. Example board layout 4214862/A: 8X 1.4 x 0.45 mm pads, 0.65 mm pitch, 4.4 mm row span (same drawing as the INA301A3IDGKR SBOS713A land).
